stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查看患者病历并回答案例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: hyperactive delirium with urinary tract infection
title.zh: 展开案例：尿路感染伴活动过度型谵妄

summary.en: An 82-year-old woman with mild Alzheimer-type dementia has an abrupt 36-hour change from baseline, including visual hallucinations, agitation, poor intake, new urinary incontinence, and failure to recognize her daughter. The daughter states this is not her usual dementia pattern.
summary.zh: 一名82岁女性有轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆，36小时内突然偏离基线，出现视幻觉、躁动、进食差、新发尿失禁，并认不出女儿。女儿说明这并不是她平时的痴呆表现。

content.en: Lives in assisted living. Baseline: oriented to person and place, manages meals and grooming with cueing, converses coherently with occasional word-finding pauses, sleeps through the night. History: mild Alzheimer-type dementia, hypertension, osteoarthritis, type 2 diabetes managed with metformin, remote hip fracture repair. Allergy: sulfonamides (rash). Home medications: lisinopril 10 mg daily, acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hr PRN joint pain, metformin 500 mg twice daily, multivitamin daily. No indwelling urinary catheter, no recent hospitalization, no reported fall or head trauma, no new medications, no alcohol use.
content.zh: 住在协助生活机构。基线：能定向到本人和地点，在提示下能自行进餐和梳洗，交谈连贯但偶有找词困难，夜间可整夜睡眠。病史：轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆、高血压、骨关节炎、二型糖尿病（服用二甲双胍）、三年前髋部骨折修复。过敏：磺胺类药物（皮疹）。家庭用药：赖诺普利10 mg每日一次、对乙酰氨基酚650 mg每6小时按需用于关节痛、二甲双胍500 mg每日两次、每日复合维生素。无留置导尿管，近期未住院，未报告跌倒或头部外伤，无新增用药，无饮酒。

title.en: Emergency department assessment and initial data

content.en: Daughter reports: over 36 hr the client became "a completely different person," talked to people who were not there, tried to climb over the bed rail, slept only in brief agitated bursts, refused breakfast, pulled out her hearing aid, and was incontinent of urine twice overnight. Vital signs: T 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) oral, HR 104/min, BP 148/82 mm Hg, RR 20/min, SpO₂ 96% room air. Exam: restless, pulling at gown and blood-pressure cuff, inconsistent command following, oriented to person only, dry mucous membranes, decreased skin turgor, mild suprapubic tenderness, no costovertebral-angle tenderness, no focal motor deficit. Straight catheter specimen: 60 mL cloudy malodorous urine. Labs: WBC 14.2 ×10³/µL with 82% neutrophils and 6% bands; Hgb 11.8 g/dL; platelets 210 ×10³/µL; Na 146 mEq/L; K 4.0 mEq/L; Cl 108 mEq/L; HCO₃ 24 mEq/L; BUN 32 mg/dL; creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (baseline 0.9); glucose 158 mg/dL; lactate 1.6 mmol/L. Urinalysis: amber, cloudy, specific gravity 1.028, positive leukocyte esterase, positive nitrites, large bacteria, 50-100 WBC/hpf, trace protein. Blood cultures and urine culture sent. Head CT: no acute intracranial pathology.
content.zh: 女儿报告：过去36小时患者“像变了一个人”，对不存在的人说话，试图翻越床栏，只能短暂而躁动地睡眠，拒绝早餐，拔掉助听器，夜间两次尿失禁。生命体征：口温100.9 °F (38.3 °C)，心率104次/分，血压148/82 mm Hg，呼吸20次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 96%。查体：躁动，拉扯病号服和血压袖带，不能稳定执行指令，仅能定向到本人，口黏膜干燥，皮肤弹性下降，耻骨上轻压痛，无肋脊角叩痛，无局灶性运动缺损。一次性直导尿标本：60 mL浑浊且有异味尿液。实验室：白细胞14.2 ×10³/µL，中性粒82%，杆状核6%；血红蛋白11.8 g/dL；血小板210 ×10³/µL；钠146 mEq/L；钾4.0 mEq/L；氯108 mEq/L；碳酸氢根24 mEq/L；BUN 32 mg/dL；肌酐1.3 mg/dL（基线0.9）；血糖158 mg/dL；乳酸1.6 mmol/L。尿检：琥珀色、浑浊，比重1.028，白细胞酯酶阳性，亚硝酸盐阳性，大量细菌，白细胞50-100/高倍视野，微量蛋白。已送血培养和尿培养。头颅CT：无急性颅内病变。

content.en: Orders: ceftriaxone 1 g IV every 24 hr; 0.9% sodium chloride 500 mL IV over 2 hr; maintenance IV fluids at 75 mL/hr. The sulfonamide allergy is documented so sulfonamide antibiotics are avoided. During transport the client attempts to stand on the stretcher, swings at the transporter, and shouts, "Get away from me!" Nursing actions: lights dimmed, calm low voice used, gentle reorientation provided, bed placed in lowest position, call light within reach, daughter invited to remain as a familiar presence, hearing aid cleaned and replaced. CAM screen: acute onset yes; inattention yes; disorganized thinking yes; altered level of consciousness yes with fluctuation between hyperalert agitation and brief drowsiness. CAM positive; provider notified. Hour 3: T 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), HR 98/min, BP 140/78 mm Hg, RR 18/min, SpO₂ 97%. Urine output: 40 mL in 2 hr, dark amber. Takes only a few sips of water.
content.zh: 医嘱：头孢曲松1 g静脉给药，每24小时一次；0.9%氯化钠500 mL静脉输注2小时；维持静脉液75 mL/小时。已记录磺胺类过敏，因此避免使用磺胺类抗生素。转运途中患者试图从担架上站起，挥手打转运人员，并喊“离我远点！”护理措施：调暗灯光，用低而平静的声音交流，温和再定向，床置最低位，呼叫铃置于可及处，邀请女儿留在床旁作为熟悉陪伴，清洁并重新戴上助听器。CAM筛查：急性起病——是；注意力不集中——是；思维紊乱——是；意识水平改变——是，在高度警觉躁动和短暂嗜睡之间波动。CAM阳性，已通知医务人员。第3小时：体温100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，心率98次/分，血压140/78 mm Hg，呼吸18次/分，SpO₂ 97%。尿量：2小时40 mL，深琥珀色。仅饮少量水。

title.en: Response to fluids and ongoing delirium risk
title.zh: 补液反应与持续谵妄风险

content.en: IV bolus complete. Hour 10 vitals: T 99.7 °F (37.6 °C), HR 92/min, BP 134/76 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO₂ 98%. Less combative but still confused; intermittently recognizes daughter, misidentifies room and time, repeatedly picks at IV site, has dislodged saline lock once, sleeps in 20-minute stretches, then wakes and calls out. Daughter has been at bedside for 10 hr and is exhausted and tearful. Hour 12 labs: WBC 12.8 ×10³/µL; Na 143 mEq/L; BUN 28 mg/dL; creatinine 1.1 mg/dL; glucose 142 mg/dL. Urine output over past 4 hr: 160 mL, light yellow. Preliminary urine culture: >100,000 CFU/mL Escherichia coli; susceptibilities pending. Braden Scale score 14; high fall-risk score; no meal intake since admission. Bed alarm active.
content.zh: 静脉补液已完成。第10小时生命体征：体温99.7 °F (37.6 °C)，心率92次/分，血压134/76 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，SpO₂ 98%。攻击性减轻但仍意识混乱；间断能认出女儿，仍认错房间和时间，反复抠抓静脉部位，曾一次弄脱盐水锁，睡眠每次约20分钟后惊醒呼喊。女儿已在床旁10小时，疲惫且流泪。第12小时实验室：白细胞12.8 ×10³/µL；钠143 mEq/L；BUN 28 mg/dL；肌酐1.1 mg/dL；血糖142 mg/dL。过去4小时尿量160 mL，淡黄色。尿培养初报：大肠埃希菌>100,000 CFU/mL，药敏待回报。Braden评分14分；跌倒风险高；入院后未进正餐。床报警器已启用。

title.en: PRN severe-agitation order and facility safety checks
title.zh: 严重躁动按需医嘱与机构安全核查

content.en: Provider order: haloperidol 0.5 mg PO every 6 hr PRN severe agitation that creates imminent risk of self-harm or harm to others; if the client cannot safely take oral medication, contact the provider for an IM route order. Use only if non-pharmacologic measures fail. Facility protocol before first dose when feasible: verify recent ECG/QTc or obtain ECG per protocol; review potassium and magnesium status and other QT-prolonging medications; screen for Parkinson disease or dementia with Lewy bodies; document the safety threat and failed non-pharmacologic measures. After dose: reassess agitation and level of sedation within 30-60 min; monitor for hypotension, extrapyramidal symptoms, and oversedation; continue least-restrictive delirium care.
content.zh: 医嘱：氟哌啶醇0.5 mg口服，每6小时按需，用于造成患者自身或他人即刻伤害风险的严重躁动；如果患者不能安全口服，需联系医务人员改开肌内给药途径。仅在非药物措施无效后使用。机构首次给药前安全流程（可行时）：确认近期心电图/QTc或按流程做心电图；查看钾、镁状态及其他延长QT的药物；筛查帕金森病或路易体痴呆；记录安全威胁以及已尝试但无效的非药物措施。给药后：30-60分钟内复评躁动和镇静程度；监测低血压、锥体外系反应和过度镇静；继续采用限制性最小的谵妄护理。

content.en: Overnight the provider issued an IM route order, and the client received one IM dose of haloperidol after repeated non-pharmacologic measures failed and she climbed over the side rail despite the bed alarm. ECG/QTc and electrolyte review met facility parameters before administration. She calmed within 30 min and slept for 3 hr. Morning assessment: T 98.8 °F (37.1 °C), HR 82/min, BP 130/72 mm Hg, RR 14/min, SpO₂ 98%. Drowsy but arousable; follows one-step commands; recognizes daughter by name; still believes she is at home and gives the year as "the nineties." Ate half of a soft breakfast with cueing. Urine output past 8 hr: 320 mL, pale yellow. Repeat labs: WBC 10.4 ×10³/µL; Na 140 mEq/L; BUN 24 mg/dL; creatinine 1.0 mg/dL; glucose 130 mg/dL. Final urine culture: E. coli sensitive to ceftriaxone. Repeat CAM remains positive but improved: inattention persists but is less severe; answers are relevant but slow; mildly drowsy without prior hyperalert-somnolent fluctuation. Provider plans transition to oral cephalexin when full-meal tolerance is demonstrated; target discharge back to assisted living in 48-72 hr if delirium continues to clear. Daughter asks, "She's better but still not herself — when will she be back to normal?"
content.zh: 夜间，医务人员开具肌内给药途径医嘱；在多次非药物措施无效且患者虽有床报警仍翻越床栏后，给予一次肌内氟哌啶醇。给药前心电图/QTc和电解质复核符合机构参数。30分钟内安静下来，并睡了3小时。晨间评估：体温98.8 °F (37.1 °C)，心率82次/分，血压130/72 mm Hg，呼吸14次/分，SpO₂ 98%。嗜睡但可唤醒；能执行一步指令；能叫出女儿名字；仍认为自己在家，并说年份是“九十年代”。在提示下吃了半份软食早餐。过去8小时尿量320 mL，淡黄色。复查实验室：白细胞10.4 ×10³/µL；钠140 mEq/L；BUN 24 mg/dL；肌酐1.0 mg/dL；血糖130 mg/dL。尿培养最终结果：大肠埃希菌，对头孢曲松敏感。复查CAM仍阳性但改善：注意力不集中仍存在但减轻；回答相关但缓慢；轻度嗜睡，不再出现之前高度警觉和嗜睡之间的波动。医务人员计划在患者能耐受完整一餐后转为口服头孢氨苄；若谵妄继续缓解，目标48-72小时后回协助生活机构。女儿问：“她好多了，但还不像自己——什么时候才能恢复正常？”

stem.en: Stage 2: The client has a Braden Scale score of 14, high fall risk, poor intake, urinary incontinence, disrupted sleep, and ongoing confusion. Which nursing interventions reduce hospital-acquired complication risk? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段2：患者Braden评分14分、跌倒风险高、摄入差、尿失禁、睡眠中断且仍意识混乱。哪些护理措施能降低医院获得性并发症风险？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Stage 1: For each cue, identify whether it most strongly supports acute delirium from an infection/dehydration process or the client's known baseline dementia.
stem.zh: 阶段1：对每个线索，判断其最能支持感染/脱水过程导致的急性谵妄，还是患者已知的基线痴呆。

rows.en: Abrupt change over 36 hr from usual cognition and behavior
rows.zh: 36小时内认知和行为突然偏离平时状态

rows.en: CAM positive with inattention, disorganized thinking, and fluctuating level of consciousness
rows.zh: CAM阳性，伴注意力不集中、思维紊乱和意识水平波动

rows.en: Baseline word-finding pauses with orientation to person and place
rows.zh: 基线表现为偶有找词困难，但能定向到本人和地点

rows.en: Fever, leukocytosis with bands, suprapubic tenderness, and nitrite-positive pyuric urine
rows.zh: 发热、白细胞升高伴杆状核、耻骨上压痛以及亚硝酸盐阳性且脓尿

rows.en: Mild Alzheimer-type dementia documented 6 months ago
rows.zh: 6个月前记录有轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆

correct.en: The acute 36-hour change, fluctuating attention and consciousness, positive CAM, fever, inflammatory markers, suprapubic tenderness, and abnormal urinalysis support delirium triggered by symptomatic infection and dehydration. Her documented mild Alzheimer-type dementia explains chronic baseline memory and word-finding limitations but does not explain the abrupt febrile fluctuating presentation.
correct.zh: 36小时内急性改变、注意力和意识水平波动、CAM阳性、发热、炎症指标、耻骨上压痛和异常尿检，支持由有症状感染和脱水诱发的谵妄。既往记录的轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆可解释慢性的记忆和找词困难，但不能解释这种突然、发热且波动的表现。

byChoice.en: A rapid change over hours to days is a classic delirium cue, especially when the daughter can describe a clear baseline.
byChoice.zh: 数小时到数天内快速改变是谵妄典型线索，尤其当女儿能清楚描述患者基线时。

byChoice.en: CAM findings of inattention and fluctuating consciousness point to delirium rather than a slow dementia trajectory.
byChoice.zh: CAM提示注意力不集中和意识波动，更符合谵妄，而不是缓慢进展的痴呆。

byChoice.en: Occasional word-finding difficulty with preserved person/place orientation is the client's stated baseline and should not be mistaken for the acute problem.
byChoice.zh: 偶有找词困难且仍能定向到本人和地点，是患者原有基线，不应误认为此次急性问题。

byChoice.en: Systemic and urinary findings identify a reversible precipitant for delirium rather than isolated chronic cognitive decline.
byChoice.zh: 全身感染和泌尿系统线索指出谵妄的可逆诱因，而不是单纯慢性认知下降。

byChoice.en: A known dementia diagnosis increases delirium risk and provides the baseline comparison; it does not by itself explain the abrupt syndrome.
byChoice.zh: 已知痴呆会增加谵妄风险，并提供基线对照；但它本身不能解释这种突然发生的综合征。

testTakingStrategy.en: When dementia is in the history, do not stop there. Compare the current presentation with baseline and look for acute fluctuation, inattention, and reversible triggers.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 病史中有痴呆时，不要就此停止判断。要把当前表现与基线比较，并寻找急性波动、注意力不集中和可逆诱因。

stem.en: Stage 1: The client attempts to stand on the stretcher and swings at staff during transport. Which nursing action has the highest priority?
stem.zh: 阶段1：患者在转运途中试图从担架上站起，并挥手打工作人员。哪项护理措施优先级最高？

options.en: Request a benzodiazepine before attempting environmental or sensory interventions.
options.zh: 在尝试环境或感官干预之前，先要求使用苯二氮䓬类药物。

options.en: Stay with the client, lower the bed, use a calm voice, and redirect her while protecting her from falling.
options.zh: 留在患者身边，降低床位，用平静语气交流，并在防止跌倒的同时重新引导她。

options.en: Tell the daughter that the behavior is expected progression of dementia and ask her to leave so the client can rest.
options.zh: 告诉女儿这是痴呆进展的预期表现，并请她离开以便患者休息。

options.en: Apply bilateral wrist restraints immediately because the client is combative.
options.zh: 因患者有攻击性，立即使用双侧腕部约束。

correct.en: Immediate physical safety is the priority. Hyperactive delirium creates high fall and injury risk, so the nurse should remain with the client, keep the bed low, use calm de-escalation, and redirect or reorient while preserving least-restrictive care.
correct.zh: 当前优先是立即保障身体安全。活动过度型谵妄会显著增加跌倒和受伤风险，因此护士应留在患者身边，保持床位低，用平静方式降级处理，并在限制性最小的前提下重新引导或再定向。

byChoice.en: Restraints can worsen agitation and delirium and are not the first response when least-restrictive safety measures can be attempted.
byChoice.zh: 约束可能加重躁动和谵妄；在可尝试限制性更小的安全措施时，不应作为首选。

byChoice.en: Benzodiazepines can worsen delirium in older adults unless there is a specific indication such as alcohol or benzodiazepine withdrawal.
byChoice.zh: 除酒精或苯二氮䓬类戒断等特定适应证外，苯二氮䓬类可加重老年人谵妄。

byChoice.en: This addresses the immediate fall/injury threat and uses first-line non-pharmacologic delirium care.
byChoice.zh: 该措施处理当前跌倒/受伤威胁，并采用谵妄的一线非药物护理。

byChoice.en: The presentation is acute and potentially reversible, and the daughter is a valuable source of baseline information and familiar reassurance.
byChoice.zh: 这种表现是急性且可能可逆的；女儿能提供基线资料，也能作为熟悉的安抚来源。

testTakingStrategy.en: For an agitated client, choose the option that prevents immediate harm while using the least restrictive effective intervention.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 面对躁动患者，选择既能防止即刻伤害、又采用有效且限制性最小措施的选项。

stem.en: Stage 2: The PRN haloperidol order may be used only for severe agitation that creates an imminent safety threat after non-pharmacologic measures fail. Which nursing actions are appropriate before or after giving this medication? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段2：按需氟哌啶醇医嘱仅可用于非药物措施失败后、造成即刻安全威胁的严重躁动。给药前后哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Review ECG/QTc status, potassium/magnesium status, and other QT-prolonging medications per facility protocol.
options.zh: 按机构流程查看心电图/QTc、钾/镁状态以及其他延长QT的药物。

options.en: Document the specific safety threat and the non-pharmacologic measures attempted before giving the dose.
options.zh: 给药前记录具体安全威胁以及已尝试的非药物措施。

options.en: After administration, reassess agitation, level of sedation, blood pressure, and extrapyramidal symptoms.
options.zh: 给药后复评躁动、镇静程度、血压和锥体外系反应。

options.en: Use physical restraints automatically after the medication takes effect to keep the client in bed.
options.zh: 药物起效后自动使用身体约束，使患者留在床上。

options.en: Screen for Parkinson disease or dementia with Lewy bodies before using haloperidol.
options.zh: 使用氟哌啶醇前筛查帕金森病或路易体痴呆。

options.en: Give the medication routinely at bedtime to prevent all nighttime confusion.
options.zh: 每晚睡前常规给药，以预防所有夜间意识混乱。

correct.en: For delirium-related agitation in a frail older adult, antipsychotic medication is reserved for an imminent safety threat after least-restrictive measures fail. The nurse should document the indication and failed alternatives, complete ordered or protocol-based cardiac/electrolyte and contraindication checks, and monitor effectiveness and adverse effects after administration.
correct.zh: 对于体弱老年人谵妄相关躁动，抗精神病药仅限于限制性较小措施失败且存在即刻安全威胁时使用。护士应记录适应证和失败的替代措施，完成医嘱或流程要求的心脏/电解质及禁忌证核查，并在给药后监测疗效和不良反应。

byChoice.en: The order requires failed non-pharmacologic measures and an imminent threat; documentation shows the medication is not being used for convenience.
byChoice.zh: 该医嘱要求非药物措施失败且存在即刻威胁；记录可证明用药不是为了方便照护。

byChoice.en: Parkinson disease and dementia with Lewy bodies increase risk of severe sensitivity or worsening motor symptoms with dopamine-blocking antipsychotics.
byChoice.zh: 帕金森病和路易体痴呆会增加多巴胺阻断类抗精神病药严重敏感反应或运动症状加重的风险。

byChoice.en: Haloperidol can prolong QT; ECG/QTc, electrolyte status, and other QT-prolonging drugs are safety checks before use when feasible.
byChoice.zh: 氟哌啶醇可延长QT；可行时用药前应核查心电图/QTc、电解质状态和其他延长QT药物。

byChoice.en: Restraints are not automatic after medication; they can worsen delirium and should remain a last resort under policy.
byChoice.zh: 给药后不能自动约束；约束可能加重谵妄，应始终按政策作为最后手段。

byChoice.en: Routine prophylactic sedation is not appropriate; the order is PRN for severe safety-threatening agitation only after other measures fail.
byChoice.zh: 常规预防性镇静不合适；该医嘱仅在严重且威胁安全的躁动、其他措施失败后按需使用。

byChoice.en: Monitoring response, oversedation, hypotension, and extrapyramidal effects evaluates both benefit and medication harm.
byChoice.zh: 监测反应、过度镇静、低血压和锥体外系反应，可评估疗效和药物伤害。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a PRN psychotropic is ordered for delirium, look for the triad: clear safety indication, failed non-drug measures, and monitoring for high-risk adverse effects.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 谵妄患者有按需精神类药物医嘱时，寻找三要素：明确安全适应证、非药物措施失败，以及高风险不良反应监测。

stem.en: Stage 3: Compare the client's findings across the case. For each finding, indicate whether it shows the current interventions are working or whether it requires continued monitoring because the problem has not fully resolved.
stem.zh: 阶段3：比较整个案例中的患者资料。对每项发现，判断其显示当前干预正在奏效，还是因问题尚未完全解决而需要继续监测。

rows.en: Creatinine improves from 1.3 mg/dL to 1.0 mg/dL and BUN decreases from 32 mg/dL to 24 mg/dL
rows.zh: 肌酐从1.3 mg/dL改善到1.0 mg/dL，BUN从32 mg/dL降至24 mg/dL

rows.en: Urine output improves from 40 mL in 2 hr to 320 mL in 8 hr with pale-yellow urine
rows.zh: 尿量从2小时40 mL改善为8小时320 mL，尿色淡黄

rows.en: Temperature normalizes and WBC decreases from 14.2 ×10³/µL to 10.4 ×10³/µL
rows.zh: 体温恢复正常，白细胞从14.2 ×10³/µL降至10.4 ×10³/µL

rows.en: CAM remains positive and the client is still disoriented to place and year
rows.zh: CAM仍阳性，患者仍不能定向到地点和年份

rows.en: The client eats half of a soft breakfast with cueing but has not yet tolerated a full meal
rows.zh: 患者在提示下吃了半份软食早餐，但尚未能耐受完整一餐

columns.zh: 继续监测/尚未完全解决

correct.en: Improving creatinine, BUN, sodium, urine output, fever, and WBC trend show that fluids and antibiotic therapy are addressing dehydration, prerenal kidney injury, and infection. However, a positive CAM, ongoing disorientation, and incomplete oral intake mean delirium and functional recovery are not complete and discharge planning still requires supervision and reassessment.
correct.zh: 肌酐、BUN、钠、尿量、体温和白细胞趋势改善，说明补液和抗生素治疗正在处理脱水、肾前性肾损伤和感染。但是CAM仍阳性、仍有定向障碍且口服摄入不完整，说明谵妄和功能恢复尚未完成，出院计划仍需监督和复评。

byChoice.en: Creatinine returning toward baseline with falling BUN supports resolving prerenal kidney injury.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐接近基线且BUN下降，支持肾前性肾损伤正在缓解。

byChoice.en: Improved urine output and lighter color show better hydration and renal perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 尿量增加且颜色变浅，显示水合状态和肾灌注改善。

byChoice.en: Defervescence and WBC improvement suggest the infection and inflammatory response are responding to treatment.
byChoice.zh: 退热和白细胞改善提示感染及炎症反应对治疗有反应。

byChoice.en: Improved but persistent CAM positivity means delirium is not resolved and safety planning must continue.
byChoice.zh: CAM虽改善但仍阳性，说明谵妄尚未解除，仍需继续安全计划。

byChoice.en: Partial intake is encouraging, but inadequate intake remains a risk for dehydration, malnutrition, and delayed discharge readiness.
byChoice.zh: 部分进食令人鼓舞，但摄入不足仍会增加脱水、营养不良和延迟达到出院条件的风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: Trend questions are not solved by one value. Compare direction over time and separate physiologic improvement from unresolved safety or functional problems.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 趋势题不能只看单个数值。要比较随时间变化的方向，并区分生理改善与尚未解决的安全或功能问题。

stem.en: Stage 3: The daughter asks, "She's better but still not herself — when will she be back to normal?" Which response by the nurse is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 阶段3：女儿问：“她好多了，但还不像自己——什么时候才能恢复正常？”护士哪项回应最合适？

options.en: "The improvement is encouraging. Delirium often clears gradually over days to weeks, sometimes longer in someone with dementia. Our goal is return to her usual baseline, and the facility will need to know what supervision she still needs."
options.zh: “她的改善令人鼓舞。谵妄通常会在数天到数周内逐渐缓解，有痴呆的人有时需要更久。我们的目标是让她回到平时基线，协助生活机构也需要了解她仍需要哪些监督。”

options.en: "This behavior means her dementia has permanently advanced, so you should arrange memory-care placement now."
options.zh: “这种行为说明她的痴呆已经永久进展，所以你现在就应该安排记忆照护机构。”

options.en: "Since the antibiotic is working, she should be completely back to normal by tomorrow."
options.zh: “既然抗生素有效，她明天应该就能完全恢复正常。”

options.en: "Try not to ask about the timeline; talking about it can make her confusion worse."
options.zh: “尽量不要问恢复时间；谈这个会让她更混乱。”

correct.en: This response validates the daughter's concern, recognizes that improvement is real, sets realistic expectations that delirium may resolve more slowly than infection markers, and frames the goal as return to the client's baseline rather than immediate full orientation. It also connects persistent delirium to safe discharge planning.
correct.zh: 该回应肯定女儿的担忧，承认改善是真实的，并说明谵妄的缓解可能比感染指标改善更慢；同时把目标设定为恢复到患者原有基线，而不是立即完全定向，并将持续谵妄与安全出院计划联系起来。

byChoice.en: This overpromises rapid recovery and may increase family distress if cognition lags behind medical improvement.
byChoice.zh: 该说法过度承诺快速恢复；如果认知恢复落后于医学改善，可能增加家属焦虑。

byChoice.en: This is therapeutic, accurate, and discharge-focused without overpromising or treating the episode as permanent decline.
byChoice.zh: 该回应具有治疗性且准确，关注出院安全，既不过度承诺，也不把本次发作视为永久衰退。

byChoice.en: Avoiding the question is not therapeutic; the family needs clear expectations and safety planning.
byChoice.zh: 回避问题不具治疗性；家属需要明确预期和安全计划。

byChoice.en: Immediate memory-care placement based on an active delirium episode is premature; reassessment after recovery is needed.
byChoice.zh: 在谵妄仍活动时立即根据当前表现安排记忆照护为时过早；需恢复后再评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: Therapeutic communication answers usually acknowledge feelings, give accurate information, and avoid false reassurance or premature conclusions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 治疗性沟通选项通常会承认感受、提供准确信息，并避免虚假安慰或过早下结论。

stem.en: Stage 2: The client has a Braden Scale score of 14, high fall risk, poor intake, urinary incontinence, disrupted sleep, and ongoing confusion. Which nursing interventions reduce hospital-acquired complication risk? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段2：患者Braden评分14分、跌倒风险高、摄入差、尿失禁、睡眠中断且仍意识混乱。哪些护理措施能降低医院获得性并发症风险？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Cluster nighttime care, reduce noise and light at night, and maintain daytime orientation cues.
options.zh: 夜间集中护理操作、减少噪声和光线，并在白天保持定向线索。

options.en: Reposition at least every 2 hr, use pressure redistribution as indicated, keep skin clean and dry, and apply moisture barrier to the perineum.
options.zh: 至少每2小时翻身，按需使用减压/压力再分布措施，保持皮肤清洁干燥，并在会阴部使用防潮屏障。

options.en: Turn off the bed alarm because alarms can be annoying for confused clients.
options.zh: 关闭床报警，因为报警声会让意识混乱的患者烦躁。

options.en: Maintain fall precautions such as bed in lowest position, bed alarm, non-skid footwear, clear pathways, and purposeful rounding.
options.zh: 维持跌倒预防措施，如床置最低位、床报警、防滑鞋、通道清理和有目的巡视。

options.en: Offer small frequent meals, fluids, and cueing; escalate nutrition support if intake does not improve.
options.zh: 提供少量多餐、液体和提示；若摄入未改善，升级营养支持。

options.en: Keep the client in bed with restraints so she does not remove the IV or fall.
options.zh: 用约束让患者留在床上，以免拔除静脉通路或跌倒。

correct.en: Delirium, immobility, incontinence, poor intake, sleep disruption, and Braden score 14 create overlapping risks for falls, pressure injury, dehydration, malnutrition, and prolonged delirium. Prevention requires a bundle: fall precautions, skin and moisture care, nutrition/hydration support, and sleep-preserving delirium care.
correct.zh: 谵妄、活动受限、尿失禁、摄入差、睡眠中断和Braden评分14分共同增加跌倒、压力性损伤、脱水、营养不良和谵妄延长的风险。预防需要成套措施：跌倒预防、皮肤与潮湿管理、营养/水合支持，以及保护睡眠的谵妄护理。

byChoice.en: These measures address the documented high fall risk without jumping to restraints.
byChoice.zh: 这些措施能处理已记录的高跌倒风险，而不直接使用约束。

byChoice.en: Sleep preservation and day-night orientation reduce delirium triggers while still allowing needed care.
byChoice.zh: 保护睡眠和维持昼夜定向可减少谵妄诱因，同时仍能完成必要护理。

byChoice.en: The bed alarm is part of the fall-prevention plan; removing it without an alternative increases injury risk.
byChoice.zh: 床报警是跌倒预防计划的一部分；在没有替代措施时关闭会增加受伤风险。

byChoice.en: Braden score 14 plus incontinence and reduced mobility justify pressure-injury prevention and moisture protection.
byChoice.zh: Braden评分14分，加上尿失禁和活动受限，支持进行压力性损伤预防和防潮保护。

byChoice.en: Restraints are not a routine fall-prevention tool and can worsen agitation, injury risk, and delirium.
byChoice.zh: 约束不是常规跌倒预防工具，还可能加重躁动、受伤风险和谵妄。

byChoice.en: Poor intake worsens dehydration, weakness, and delirium risk; cueing and escalation support recovery.
byChoice.zh: 摄入差会加重脱水、虚弱和谵妄风险；提示进食和升级支持有助恢复。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several geriatric risks converge, choose bundled prevention measures that address mobility, skin, nutrition, hydration, sleep, and safety together.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个老年风险同时存在时，选择成套预防措施，同时处理活动、皮肤、营养、水合、睡眠和安全。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
查看患者病历并回答案例题。
Unfolding case: hyperactive delirium with urinary tract infection
展开案例：尿路感染伴活动过度型谵妄

An 82-year-old woman with mild Alzheimer-type dementia has an abrupt 36-hour change from baseline, including visual hallucinations, agitation, poor intake, new urinary incontinence, and failure to recognize her daughter. The daughter states this is not her usual dementia pattern.
一名82岁女性有轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆，36小时内突然偏离基线，出现视幻觉、躁动、进食差、新发尿失禁，并认不出女儿。女儿说明这并不是她平时的痴呆表现。

Lives in assisted living. Baseline: oriented to person and place, manages meals and grooming with cueing, converses coherently with occasional word-finding pauses, sleeps through the night. History: mild Alzheimer-type dementia, hypertension, osteoarthritis, type 2 diabetes managed with metformin, remote hip fracture repair. Allergy: sulfonamides (rash). Home medications: lisinopril 10 mg daily, acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hr PRN joint pain, metformin 500 mg twice daily, multivitamin daily. No indwelling urinary catheter, no recent hospitalization, no reported fall or head trauma, no new medications, no alcohol use.

住在协助生活机构。基线：能定向到本人和地点，在提示下能自行进餐和梳洗，交谈连贯但偶有找词困难，夜间可整夜睡眠。病史：轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆、高血压、骨关节炎、二型糖尿病（服用二甲双胍）、三年前髋部骨折修复。过敏：磺胺类药物（皮疹）。家庭用药：赖诺普利10 mg每日一次、对乙酰氨基酚650 mg每6小时按需用于关节痛、二甲双胍500 mg每日两次、每日复合维生素。无留置导尿管，近期未住院，未报告跌倒或头部外伤，无新增用药，无饮酒。

Daughter reports: over 36 hr the client became "a completely different person," talked to people who were not there, tried to climb over the bed rail, slept only in brief agitated bursts, refused breakfast, pulled out her hearing aid, and was incontinent of urine twice overnight. Vital signs: T 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) oral, HR 104/min, BP 148/82 mm Hg, RR 20/min, SpO₂ 96% room air. Exam: restless, pulling at gown and blood-pressure cuff, inconsistent command following, oriented to person only, dry mucous membranes, decreased skin turgor, mild suprapubic tenderness, no costovertebral-angle tenderness, no focal motor deficit. Straight catheter specimen: 60 mL cloudy malodorous urine. Labs: WBC 14.2 ×10³/µL with 82% neutrophils and 6% bands; Hgb 11.8 g/dL; platelets 210 ×10³/µL; Na 146 mEq/L; K 4.0 mEq/L; Cl 108 mEq/L; HCO₃ 24 mEq/L; BUN 32 mg/dL; creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (baseline 0.9); glucose 158 mg/dL; lactate 1.6 mmol/L. Urinalysis: amber, cloudy, specific gravity 1.028, positive leukocyte esterase, positive nitrites, large bacteria, 50-100 WBC/hpf, trace protein. Blood cultures and urine culture sent. Head CT: no acute intracranial pathology.

女儿报告：过去36小时患者“像变了一个人”，对不存在的人说话，试图翻越床栏，只能短暂而躁动地睡眠，拒绝早餐，拔掉助听器，夜间两次尿失禁。生命体征：口温100.9 °F (38.3 °C)，心率104次/分，血压148/82 mm Hg，呼吸20次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 96%。查体：躁动，拉扯病号服和血压袖带，不能稳定执行指令，仅能定向到本人，口黏膜干燥，皮肤弹性下降，耻骨上轻压痛，无肋脊角叩痛，无局灶性运动缺损。一次性直导尿标本：60 mL浑浊且有异味尿液。实验室：白细胞14.2 ×10³/µL，中性粒82%，杆状核6%；血红蛋白11.8 g/dL；血小板210 ×10³/µL；钠146 mEq/L；钾4.0 mEq/L；氯108 mEq/L；碳酸氢根24 mEq/L；BUN 32 mg/dL；肌酐1.3 mg/dL（基线0.9）；血糖158 mg/dL；乳酸1.6 mmol/L。尿检：琥珀色、浑浊，比重1.028，白细胞酯酶阳性，亚硝酸盐阳性，大量细菌，白细胞50-100/高倍视野，微量蛋白。已送血培养和尿培养。头颅CT：无急性颅内病变。
Emergency department assessment and initial data

Orders: ceftriaxone 1 g IV every 24 hr; 0.9% sodium chloride 500 mL IV over 2 hr; maintenance IV fluids at 75 mL/hr. The sulfonamide allergy is documented so sulfonamide antibiotics are avoided. During transport the client attempts to stand on the stretcher, swings at the transporter, and shouts, "Get away from me!" Nursing actions: lights dimmed, calm low voice used, gentle reorientation provided, bed placed in lowest position, call light within reach, daughter invited to remain as a familiar presence, hearing aid cleaned and replaced. CAM screen: acute onset yes; inattention yes; disorganized thinking yes; altered level of consciousness yes with fluctuation between hyperalert agitation and brief drowsiness. CAM positive; provider notified. Hour 3: T 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), HR 98/min, BP 140/78 mm Hg, RR 18/min, SpO₂ 97%. Urine output: 40 mL in 2 hr, dark amber. Takes only a few sips of water.

医嘱：头孢曲松1 g静脉给药，每24小时一次；0.9%氯化钠500 mL静脉输注2小时；维持静脉液75 mL/小时。已记录磺胺类过敏，因此避免使用磺胺类抗生素。转运途中患者试图从担架上站起，挥手打转运人员，并喊“离我远点！”护理措施：调暗灯光，用低而平静的声音交流，温和再定向，床置最低位，呼叫铃置于可及处，邀请女儿留在床旁作为熟悉陪伴，清洁并重新戴上助听器。CAM筛查：急性起病——是；注意力不集中——是；思维紊乱——是；意识水平改变——是，在高度警觉躁动和短暂嗜睡之间波动。CAM阳性，已通知医务人员。第3小时：体温100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，心率98次/分，血压140/78 mm Hg，呼吸18次/分，SpO₂ 97%。尿量：2小时40 mL，深琥珀色。仅饮少量水。

IV bolus complete. Hour 10 vitals: T 99.7 °F (37.6 °C), HR 92/min, BP 134/76 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO₂ 98%. Less combative but still confused; intermittently recognizes daughter, misidentifies room and time, repeatedly picks at IV site, has dislodged saline lock once, sleeps in 20-minute stretches, then wakes and calls out. Daughter has been at bedside for 10 hr and is exhausted and tearful. Hour 12 labs: WBC 12.8 ×10³/µL; Na 143 mEq/L; BUN 28 mg/dL; creatinine 1.1 mg/dL; glucose 142 mg/dL. Urine output over past 4 hr: 160 mL, light yellow. Preliminary urine culture: >100,000 CFU/mL Escherichia coli; susceptibilities pending. Braden Scale score 14; high fall-risk score; no meal intake since admission. Bed alarm active.

静脉补液已完成。第10小时生命体征：体温99.7 °F (37.6 °C)，心率92次/分，血压134/76 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，SpO₂ 98%。攻击性减轻但仍意识混乱；间断能认出女儿，仍认错房间和时间，反复抠抓静脉部位，曾一次弄脱盐水锁，睡眠每次约20分钟后惊醒呼喊。女儿已在床旁10小时，疲惫且流泪。第12小时实验室：白细胞12.8 ×10³/µL；钠143 mEq/L；BUN 28 mg/dL；肌酐1.1 mg/dL；血糖142 mg/dL。过去4小时尿量160 mL，淡黄色。尿培养初报：大肠埃希菌>100,000 CFU/mL，药敏待回报。Braden评分14分；跌倒风险高；入院后未进正餐。床报警器已启用。
Response to fluids and ongoing delirium risk
补液反应与持续谵妄风险

Provider order: haloperidol 0.5 mg PO every 6 hr PRN severe agitation that creates imminent risk of self-harm or harm to others; if the client cannot safely take oral medication, contact the provider for an IM route order. Use only if non-pharmacologic measures fail. Facility protocol before first dose when feasible: verify recent ECG/QTc or obtain ECG per protocol; review potassium and magnesium status and other QT-prolonging medications; screen for Parkinson disease or dementia with Lewy bodies; document the safety threat and failed non-pharmacologic measures. After dose: reassess agitation and level of sedation within 30-60 min; monitor for hypotension, extrapyramidal symptoms, and oversedation; continue least-restrictive delirium care.

医嘱：氟哌啶醇0.5 mg口服，每6小时按需，用于造成患者自身或他人即刻伤害风险的严重躁动；如果患者不能安全口服，需联系医务人员改开肌内给药途径。仅在非药物措施无效后使用。机构首次给药前安全流程（可行时）：确认近期心电图/QTc或按流程做心电图；查看钾、镁状态及其他延长QT的药物；筛查帕金森病或路易体痴呆；记录安全威胁以及已尝试但无效的非药物措施。给药后：30-60分钟内复评躁动和镇静程度；监测低血压、锥体外系反应和过度镇静；继续采用限制性最小的谵妄护理。
PRN severe-agitation order and facility safety checks
严重躁动按需医嘱与机构安全核查

Overnight the provider issued an IM route order, and the client received one IM dose of haloperidol after repeated non-pharmacologic measures failed and she climbed over the side rail despite the bed alarm. 数小时到数天内快速改变是谵妄典型线索，尤其当女儿能清楚描述患者基线时。

全身感染和泌尿系统线索指出谵妄的可逆诱因，而不是单纯慢性认知下降。

已知痴呆会增加谵妄风险，并提供基线对照；但它本身不能解释这种突然发生的综合征。

The acute 36-hour change, fluctuating attention and consciousness, positive CAM, fever, inflammatory markers, suprapubic tenderness, and abnormal urinalysis support delirium triggered by symptomatic infection and dehydration. Her documented mild Alzheimer-type dementia explains chronic baseline memory and word-finding limitations but does not explain the abrupt febrile fluctuating presentation.
36小时内急性改变、注意力和意识水平波动、CAM阳性、发热、炎症指标、耻骨上压痛和异常尿检，支持由有症状感染和脱水诱发的谵妄。既往记录的轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆可解释慢性的记忆和找词困难，但不能解释这种突然、发热且波动的表现。
When dementia is in the history, do not stop there. Compare the current presentation with baseline and look for acute fluctuation, inattention, and reversible triggers.
病史中有痴呆时，不要就此停止判断。要把当前表现与基线比较，并寻找急性波动、注意力不集中和可逆诱因。

告诉女儿这是痴呆进展的预期表现，并请她离开以便患者休息。

因患者有攻击性，立即使用双侧腕部约束。

约束可能加重躁动和谵妄；在可尝试限制性更小的安全措施时，不应作为首选。

除酒精或苯二氮䓬类戒断等特定适应证外，苯二氮䓬类可加重老年人谵妄。

该措施处理当前跌倒/受伤威胁，并采用谵妄的一线非药物护理。
The presentation is acute and potentially reversible, and the daughter is a valuable source of baseline information and familiar reassurance.
这种表现是急性且可能可逆的；女儿能提供基线资料，也能作为熟悉的安抚来源。

当前优先是立即保障身体安全。活动过度型谵妄会显著增加跌倒和受伤风险，因此护士应留在患者身边，保持床位低，用平静方式降级处理，并在限制性最小的前提下重新引导或再定向。
For an agitated client, choose the option that prevents immediate harm while using the least restrictive effective intervention.
面对躁动患者，选择既能防止即刻伤害、又采用有效且限制性最小措施的选项。

Stage 2: The PRN haloperidol order may be used only for severe agitation that creates an imminent safety threat after non-pharmacologic measures fail. Which nursing actions are appropriate before or after giving this medication? Select all that apply.

Review ECG/QTc status, potassium/magnesium status, and other QT-prolonging medications per facility protocol.
按机构流程查看心电图/QTc、钾/镁状态以及其他延长QT的药物。
Document the specific safety threat and the non-pharmacologic measures attempted before giving the dose.
给药前记录具体安全威胁以及已尝试的非药物措施。
After administration, reassess agitation, level of sedation, blood pressure, and extrapyramidal symptoms.
给药后复评躁动、镇静程度、血压和锥体外系反应。
Use physical restraints automatically after the medication takes effect to keep the client in bed.
药物起效后自动使用身体约束，使患者留在床上。
Screen for Parkinson disease or dementia with Lewy bodies before using haloperidol.
使用氟哌啶醇前筛查帕金森病或路易体痴呆。
Give the medication routinely at bedtime to prevent all nighttime confusion.
每晚睡前常规给药，以预防所有夜间意识混乱。
The order requires failed non-pharmacologic measures and an imminent threat; documentation shows the medication is not being used for convenience.
该医嘱要求非药物措施失败且存在即刻威胁；记录可证明用药不是为了方便照护。
Parkinson disease and dementia with Lewy bodies increase risk of severe sensitivity or worsening motor symptoms with dopamine-blocking antipsychotics.
帕金森病和路易体痴呆会增加多巴胺阻断类抗精神病药严重敏感反应或运动症状加重的风险。
Haloperidol can prolong QT; ECG/QTc, electrolyte status, and other QT-prolonging drugs are safety checks before use when feasible.
氟哌啶醇可延长QT；可行时用药前应核查心电图/QTc、电解质状态和其他延长QT药物。
Restraints are not automatic after medication; they can worsen delirium and should remain a last resort under policy.
给药后不能自动约束；约束可能加重谵妄，应始终按政策作为最后手段。
Routine prophylactic sedation is not appropriate; the order is PRN for severe safety-threatening agitation only after other measures fail.
常规预防性镇静不合适；该医嘱仅在严重且威胁安全的躁动、其他措施失败后按需使用。
Monitoring response, oversedation, hypotension, and extrapyramidal effects evaluates both benefit and medication harm.
监测反应、过度镇静、低血压和锥体外系反应，可评估疗效和药物伤害。

For delirium-related agitation in a frail older adult, antipsychotic medication is reserved for an imminent safety threat after least-restrictive measures fail. The nurse should document the indication and failed alternatives, complete ordered or protocol-based cardiac/electrolyte and contraindication checks, and monitor effectiveness and adverse effects after administration.
对于体弱老年人谵妄相关躁动，抗精神病药仅限于限制性较小措施失败且存在即刻安全威胁时使用。护士应记录适应证和失败的替代措施，完成医嘱或流程要求的心脏/电解质及禁忌证核查，并在给药后监测疗效和不良反应。
When a PRN psychotropic is ordered for delirium, look for the triad: clear safety indication, failed non-drug measures, and monitoring for high-risk adverse effects.
谵妄患者有按需精神类药物医嘱时，寻找三要素：明确安全适应证、非药物措施失败，以及高风险不良反应监测。

肌酐、BUN、钠、尿量、体温和白细胞趋势改善，说明补液和抗生素治疗正在处理脱水、肾前性肾损伤和感染。但是CAM仍阳性、仍有定向障碍且口服摄入不完整，说明谵妄和功能恢复尚未完成，出院计划仍需监督和复评。

Stage 3: The daughter asks, "She's better but still not herself — when will she be back to normal?" Which response by the nurse is most appropriate?
阶段3：女儿问：“她好多了，但还不像自己——什么时候才能恢复正常？”护士哪项回应最合适？

"The improvement is encouraging. Delirium often clears gradually over days to weeks, sometimes longer in someone with dementia. Our goal is return to her usual baseline, and the facility will need to know what supervision she still needs."
“她的改善令人鼓舞。谵妄通常会在数天到数周内逐渐缓解，有痴呆的人有时需要更久。我们的目标是让她回到平时基线，协助生活机构也需要了解她仍需要哪些监督。”
"This behavior means her dementia has permanently advanced, so you should arrange memory-care placement now."
“这种行为说明她的痴呆已经永久进展，所以你现在就应该安排记忆照护机构。”
"Since the antibiotic is working, she should be completely back to normal by tomorrow."
“既然抗生素有效，她明天应该就能完全恢复正常。”
"Try not to ask about the timeline; talking about it can make her confusion worse."
“尽量不要问恢复时间；谈这个会让她更混乱。”
This overpromises rapid recovery and may increase family distress if cognition lags behind medical improvement.
该说法过度承诺快速恢复；如果认知恢复落后于医学改善，可能增加家属焦虑。
This is therapeutic, accurate, and discharge-focused without overpromising or treating the episode as permanent decline.
该回应具有治疗性且准确，关注出院安全，既不过度承诺，也不把本次发作视为永久衰退。
Avoiding the question is not therapeutic; the family needs clear expectations and safety planning.
回避问题不具治疗性；家属需要明确预期和安全计划。
Immediate memory-care placement based on an active delirium episode is premature; reassessment after recovery is needed.
在谵妄仍活动时立即根据当前表现安排记忆照护为时过早；需恢复后再评估。

This response validates the daughter's concern, recognizes that improvement is real, sets realistic expectations that delirium may resolve more slowly than infection markers, and frames the goal as return to the client's baseline rather than immediate full orientation. It also connects persistent delirium to safe discharge planning.
该回应肯定女儿的担忧，承认改善是真实的，并说明谵妄的缓解可能比感染指标改善更慢；同时把目标设定为恢复到患者原有基线，而不是立即完全定向，并将持续谵妄与安全出院计划联系起来。
Therapeutic communication answers usually acknowledge feelings, give accurate information, and avoid false reassurance or premature conclusions.
治疗性沟通选项通常会承认感受、提供准确信息，并避免虚假安慰或过早下结论。

Stage 2: The client has a Braden Scale score of 14, high fall risk, poor intake, urinary incontinence, disrupted sleep, and ongoing confusion. Which nursing interventions reduce hospital-acquired complication risk? Select all that apply.
阶段2：患者Braden评分14分、跌倒风险高、摄入差、尿失禁、睡眠中断且仍意识混乱。哪些护理措施能降低医院获得性并发症风险？选择所有适用项。
Cluster nighttime care, reduce noise and light at night, and maintain daytime orientation cues.
夜间集中护理操作、减少噪声和光线，并在白天保持定向线索。
Reposition at least every 2 hr, use pressure redistribution as indicated, keep skin clean and dry, and apply moisture barrier to the perineum.
至少每2小时翻身，按需使用减压/压力再分布措施，保持皮肤清洁干燥，并在会阴部使用防潮屏障。
Turn off the bed alarm because alarms can be annoying for confused clients.
关闭床报警，因为报警声会让意识混乱的患者烦躁。
Maintain fall precautions such as bed in lowest position, bed alarm, non-skid footwear, clear pathways, and purposeful rounding.
维持跌倒预防措施，如床置最低位、床报警、防滑鞋、通道清理和有目的巡视。
Offer small frequent meals, fluids, and cueing; escalate nutrition support if intake does not improve.
提供少量多餐、液体和提示；若摄入未改善，升级营养支持。
Keep the client in bed with restraints so she does not remove the IV or fall.
用约束让患者留在床上，以免拔除静脉通路或跌倒。
These measures address the documented high fall risk without jumping to restraints.
这些措施能处理已记录的高跌倒风险，而不直接使用约束。
Sleep preservation and day-night orientation reduce delirium triggers while still allowing needed care.
保护睡眠和维持昼夜定向可减少谵妄诱因，同时仍能完成必要护理。
The bed alarm is part of the fall-prevention plan; removing it without an alternative increases injury risk.
床报警是跌倒预防计划的一部分；在没有替代措施时关闭会增加受伤风险。
Braden score 14 plus incontinence and reduced mobility justify pressure-injury prevention and moisture protection.
Braden评分14分，加上尿失禁和活动受限，支持进行压力性损伤预防和防潮保护。
Restraints are not a routine fall-prevention tool and can worsen agitation, injury risk, and delirium.
约束不是常规跌倒预防工具，还可能加重躁动、受伤风险和谵妄。
Poor intake worsens dehydration, weakness, and delirium risk; cueing and escalation support recovery.
摄入差会加重脱水、虚弱和谵妄风险；提示进食和升级支持有助恢复。

Delirium, immobility, incontinence, poor intake, sleep disruption, and Braden score 14 create overlapping risks for falls, pressure injury, dehydration, malnutrition, and prolonged delirium. Prevention requires a bundle: fall precautions, skin and moisture care, nutrition/hydration support, and sleep-preserving delirium care.

When several geriatric risks converge, choose bundled prevention measures that address mobility, skin, nutrition, hydration, sleep, and safety together.
